shortDescription: Manages TrueCopy pairs on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: secondary_connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the secondary storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the TrueCopy pairs task.

options.name: state
options.description: The level of the TrueCopy pairs task. C(present) is used to create or update a TrueCopy pair. C(absent) is used to delete a TrueCopy pair. C(expand) or C(resize) is used to expand the size of the volumes of a TrueCopy pair. C(resync) is used to re-sync a TrueCopy pair. C(split) is used to split a TrueCopy pair. C(swap-split) is used to swap-split a TrueCopy pair. C(swap-resync) is used to swap-resync a TrueCopy pair.

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
